title: Juicy Venezuelan Serrano Ham Wraps
description: These low-carb-friendly ham wraps are packed with umami flavors and perfect for a brunch mood. Air frying keeps them juicy without the need for much oil.

ingredients.name: 1/4 cup diced red onion (optional)
ingredients.notes: For a pop of color and flavor

ingredients.name: Juice of 1 lemon
ingredients.notes: Freshly squeezed for the best flavor

instructions: Combine serrano ham with mayonnaise and add finely chopped red onion if using. Mix until well combined.
Season the mixture with salt to taste and a pinch of black pepper if desired. Adjust seasoning based on preference for umami depth.
Shape into small wraps or bite-sized pieces, ensuring each wrap is evenly coated in the ham mixture.
Preheat your air fryer to 200°C (390°F). Place the wraps in the basket and cook for about 8-10 minutes, flipping halfway through cooking time.
Remove from air fryer and let cool slightly before serving. These wraps are best enjoyed as a snack or light meal.
